title: Gloria Steinem, Personification of the Women’s Movement, Dies at 92
description: She challenged sexist assumptions, helping women develop a sense of self-worth and gain a measure of equality at work, at home and in society at large.
author: Katharine Q. Seelye

title: Can the Lindsay Clancy Jury Break Its Deadlock?
description: In general, juries that have repeatedly report an impasse are unlikely to reach consensus. But sometimes, those asked by a judge to try harder do return a verdict.
author: Jenna Russell

title: ICE Skipped Basic Checks in Rush for Recruits, Whistle-Blower Says
description: An official who oversaw the vetting of ICE recruits cited an “unprecedented lowering of standards” amid a hiring surge.
author: Alexandra Berzon, Katie Benner and Hamed Aleaziz

title: Religious Leaders Apologize for Appearing With Hindu Far-Right Group
description: Progressive faith leaders said invitations to a breakfast and an event at Madison Square Garden did not say they were tied to the Hindu nationalist group R.S.S.
author: Sarah Chatta and Maya King

title: 2 Killed and 2 Officers Shot at Minneapolis Apartment Building
description: The authorities said the suspect was also dead. Residents were warned to stay away from the downtown apartment building where the violence erupted.
author: Ernesto Londoño, Tim Arango and Christina Morales

title: Homeland Security Secretary’s Plane Makes Emergency Landing
description: The landing was the latest close call over Washington’s congested airspace to involve a senior government official.
author: Karoun Demirjian

title: Man Is Rescued From Inside Garbage Truck in San Francisco
description: The city’s Fire Department said it received a call just after 4 a.m. on Wednesday reporting that a person was stuck in the vehicle after it collected trash from a dumpster.
author: Alexandra E. Petri

title: D.S.A. Chapter Endorses Nithya Raman for Mayor of Los Angeles
description: Ms. Raman, a member of the D.S.A. chapter, is challenging Mayor Karen Bass as democratic socialists have surged nationally.
author: Jill Cowan

title: White House Plans $250,000 Renovation of 2-Lane Bowling Alley
description: A White House spokesman said the alley renovations included fixing broken lights. The project comes as the president has sought a broad overhaul of the White House and its surroundings.
author: Mack Liederman

title: El-Sayed Wants to Mend Ties With Jewish Democrats, but Some Are Still Not Impressed
description: Lingering concerns about the Senate nominee in Michigan could make it harder for him to assemble a winning coalition.
author: Bayliss Wagner and Steve Friess

title: Judge Blocks Trump’s Second Try to Restrict Birthright Citizenship
description: The ruling raised concerns that babies already defined as citizens by the Supreme Court could have their citizenship revoked under an order the president signed in August.
author: Zach Montague

title: As Midterms Loom, Democrats Feud Over Defections
description: The fight has highlighted party divisions and raised questions about how Democrats will run the House should they win the majority.
author: Michael Gold

title: States Sue Over Move to End to Federal Funds for Transgender Youth for Transition Care
description: The Trump administration wants to bar Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program from paying for gender-transition medication and surgery for transgender adolescents.
author: Amy Harmon

title: In the Midterms, Will the Nepo-Baby Attack Work?
description: A New Hampshire senator’s daughter is running for office, and finds her name being used against her.
author: Jess Bidgood

title: Woman Who Killed Husband Decades Ago Is Sentenced for Killing Wife
description: A woman in California will face 36 years to life in prison after previously serving time for a stabbing death in 2000.
author: Ishani Desai

title: Deadlocked Jury in Lindsay Clancy Trial Again Says It Can’t Reach a Verdict
description: Jurors say they cannot reach a unanimous agreement after about 30 hours of deliberations. The judge is bringing them back for one last try.
author: Maia Spoto, Mark Arsenault and Jacey Fortin

title: USPS Is Building a Mail-In Ballot Screening System Despite Legal Battles Over Trump Order
description: Election officials warn that the creation of a new online portal for states to upload voter information is already fueling confusion and could ultimately disenfranchise voters.
author: Eileen Sullivan

title: Trump Administration Launches Hunt For Noncitizen Voter Fraud Before Midterms
description: Election fraud is exceedingly rare, but President Trump has fixated on rooting it out this year, claiming without evidence that tens of thousands of noncitizens are registered to vote.
author: Nick Corasaniti and Hamed Aleaziz

title: Trump Returns to a Familiar Playbook as the War With Iran Flares Up Again
description: The United States seems increasingly bogged down in Iran after six months of conflict, despite President Trump’s declarations of military dominance.
author: Erica L. Green

title: Jay Leno’s Classic Car Bill Passes in California Legislature
description: The bipartisan bill, backed by Mr. Leno, the comedian and car collector, would exempt some older vehicles from having to meet California’s stringent emissions rules.
author: Livia Albeck-Ripka
